research_notes: AC4 counter follow-up Xbox inputs established from 2013 Prima advanced tips: X kill; B throw; A disarm/stun; Y selected tool. This is 2013 gameplay-guide evidence, not an engine-state API.
Original AC4 B is NOT just a generic context-based counter/dodge. Holding B guards; tapping B on a prompted incoming melee opens a separate timed counter menu with four face-button follow-ups.

Original AC4 High Profile RT modifies stealth assassination range/animation and traversal, and influences combat disengagement and aimed firing. High Profile must not be treated as a plain sprint key.
Resynced Takedown after defense break/perfect parry, normal/perfect dodge and enemy archetype limits are separate systems from original AC4 kill streaks.
Controller maps from July 2026 do not establish exact input priority or bindings on the owner's TU 1.0.6.
Every feature described with an unconfirmed binding is explicitly marked feature_described_binding_unverified.
User confirmed only normal Attack fired when Attack and Takedown shared a physical button in Resynced; exact available prompt at that moment unknown.
Additional guide-described exception: original AC4 B alone can produce a double counter kill when two enemy attack warnings overlap; exact eligibility and timing remain unknown.
Original AC4 A may be human shield at gunfire warning despite being break-defense in normal combat and jump in traversal; documented Xbox control, runtime priority not verified.

Resynced LB press parry / hold Observe, RB press attack / hold heavy / perch hang enemy, and R3 press target lock / hold Eagle Vision / double-tap HUD are independent context/gesture overlaps in the July 2026 table; TU1.0.6 behavior not verified.
